name: Geisler Electric
old_description: At Geisler Electric, you can trust us to treat you like family and to do a great job by providing a quick response to your call. We will send a clean, courteous, and reliable service professional that fixes your problem RIGHT the first time, all at a guaranteed price. Geisler Electric is the most on-time and efficient electrical contractor in the area – guaranteed! We’re proud to be the top electrical contractors in Kansas City, KS and the surrounding areas.
about:
Geisler Electric was founded in 2013 in Manhattan, Kansas, by Joe Geisler as a family-owned electrical contracting business. The company began with a focus on residential and commercial electrical installations, troubleshooting, and upgrades, serving the Manhattan area and surrounding communities. In 2024, the firm expanded its service territory to include the Kansas City metropolitan area.

The company provides a range of electrical services including residential and commercial wiring, panel change-outs, security system installation, home networking, EV charging station installation, smart lighting control, and generator installation. Technicians operate from fully stocked service trucks, enabling on-site repairs without additional supply runs. Geisler Electric maintains regular business hours Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with 24/7 emergency service available year-round. The company holds Kansas electrical contractor licensing.

Geisler Electric serves homeowners, businesses, and industrial facilities. Its customer base includes residential clients in Manhattan and the Kansas City metro area, commercial offices, retail spaces, and industrial operations such as a processing facility that required immediate electrical repairs. The company also supports smart home and smart building projects, integrating audio/video, automated lighting, and environmental control systems.

The firm emphasizes a family-owned, neighborly approach, aiming to treat clients like family and ensure safety through top-notch service. Its differentiators include round-the-clock emergency response, fully equipped trucks, and a commitment to completing projects with precision and care. The company states its mission is to solve electrical issues and keep customers safe in their homes and workplaces.

name: Gellco Work Outfitters
old_description: Gellco Clothing & Shoes is Oklahoma’s leading provider of Safety Footwear. With over 20 name brands and well over 200 different styles in-stock we offer by far the largest selection in the great state of Oklahoma. Gellco offers safety footwear in just about any style, category, safety feature, and price range imaginable. We know that Safety Footwear is not a one size fits all.
about:
Gellco Clothing & Shoes was founded in 1959 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company began as a single store serving the American worker with occupational footwear and work apparel.

Today the business operates five retail locations across Oklahoma City, Edmond, Broken Arrow, and Tulsa, supplemented by a fleet of six mobile shoe trucks that bring more than 1,000 pairs of safety footwear directly to job sites. The company stocks over 20 name brands and well over 200 styles of safety footwear, and is also one of Oklahoma's largest providers of flame-resistant clothing and workwear. A central shipping center in Oklahoma allows delivery to most U.S. locations within three to five days. The organization employs approximately 5,000 people according to company records.

Gellco serves companies of all sizes, from small crews of five employees to workforces of 5,000, providing corporate safety footwear and flame-resistant clothing programs. Customers include firms in construction, manufacturing, oil and gas, utilities, and other industrial sectors where OSHA-compliant personal protective equipment is required.

The company distinguishes itself through its mobile ShoeMobile service at no extra cost, a broad in-stock selection, and a focus on personal customer service that includes expert fitting, custom embroidery, flexible invoicing, and online ordering tools. Gellco's staff are trained on OSHA PPE standards to ensure workers leave compliant for the job.

name: Generac Power Systems
old_description: Manufactures backup generators and power equipment for residential and industrial customers.
about:
Generac Power Systems was founded in 1959 in Waukesha, Wisconsin. The company began by engineering the first affordable home standby generators and developing an engine purpose-built for generator use.

Today Generac manufactures a broad portfolio of power products: portable, residential, commercial, and industrial generators; manual and fully automatic transfer switches for applications up to 2 MW; a mobile line of light towers, trailer-mounted generators, and combination units built for demanding environments; and a full range of residential, commercial, and industrial power washers. The company designs and builds its own engines and power equipment across multiple product lines.

Generac serves homeowners, contractors, and industrial facilities. Its residential standby generators are sold through authorized dealers to homeowners seeking backup power. Portable generators target campers, tailgaters, and workers needing mobile power. Commercial and industrial customers use its stationary generators and transfer switches for critical infrastructure. The mobile line serves a variety of industries requiring rugged, trailer-mounted power and lighting.

Generac differentiates itself as the first to make home standby generators affordable and as the current market leader in that category. The company emphasizes quality, affordable power solutions and has pioneered categories such as residential power washers and purpose-built generator engines.

name: General Transformer Corporation
old_description: Custom transformer and magnetics manufacturer based and manufacturing entirely in Wylie, Texas since 1976.
about:
General Transformer Corporation was founded in 1976 in Wylie, Texas, where it continues to operate its manufacturing facility. The company has remained a domestic producer of custom magnetics for nearly five decades.

The company designs and builds custom transformers, inductors, chokes, line conditioners, and portable power units. Its capabilities include custom design engineering, in-house coil winding, and an ISO 9001:2015 quality system. With a staff of 2–10 employees, General Transformer handles orders ranging from small prototype quantities to production runs of thousands, and maintains a large material inventory to support quick turnaround.

Primary markets include traffic control systems, oil and gas, and general industrial OEMs. The firm also serves international customers from its Texas plant, shipping custom magnetics worldwide.

General Transformer emphasizes a collaborative 'Optimum Design' approach, working with customers to define the exact magnetic topology for each application rather than offering off‑the‑shelf products. It highlights complete control over U.S.‑based production, rigorous inspection and testing at every stage, and long‑term customer relationships measured in decades.

name: General Woodcraft Inc
old_description: Founded in 1949, General Woodcraft has a proud heritage of quality that we think is evident in the projects you see throughout this site. Our many clients, architects, designers, builders, contractors and discerning homeowners, and their projects, speak to the professional performance – on time and within budget – which we consistently deliver.
about:
General Woodcraft Inc has operated from New London, Connecticut since its founding in 1949. The company began as a woodworking shop serving architects, designers, builders, and homeowners, and has remained in the same location on Broad Street for over seven decades.

The firm provides custom woodworking and architectural millwork, including custom mouldings, mantels, countertops, and wooden boat parts. It also stocks a wide range of domestic and exotic hardwoods, marine plywood, and operates as a major supplier of Mataverde premium hardwood decking and Climate-Shield rain screen systems. The shop handles custom milling for projects of any size and offers design and installation services for kitchens, libraries, and built-in cabinetry.

Clients span the woodworking, marine, commercial, and residential construction sectors. Notable projects include supplying teak for the U.S. Coast Guard Barque Eagle and Mystic Seaport’s 19th-century sailing ship Joseph Conrad, as well as decking for the Treasure Island Casino in Las Vegas and the Clinton Library in Little Rock. The company works directly with architects, designers, contractors, and individual homeowners.

General Woodcraft emphasizes a service philosophy called TRACC — Trust, Respect, Attitude, Communication, and Consistency — and states a commitment to environmentally responsible sourcing through sustained-yield forestry methods. Its mission centers on delivering a “General Woodcraft Experience” of service and quality products.

name: Generations Millwork
old_description: We have been proudly serving all of your custom fixture needs in Oklahoma since 1990. Greet your visitors with our unique custom-designed doors. Get in touch with us today to find the type of door you're looking for.
about:
Generation III operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it was founded in April 1990 by Chuck Clowers. The business began as a carpentry crew building homes, with its first project a large residence in Oakdale Farms. After several small building jobs, the founders opened a dedicated shop and shifted focus toward cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork. The company remains locally and family-owned.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, and millwork for residential and commercial clients. Core offerings include kitchen cabinets, custom doors and mantels, wine cellars, tables, closet and media units, and one-off furniture pieces. Work is split roughly 50 percent residential projects, 30 percent commercial cabinetry (banks, law offices ranging from 1,500 to 15,000 square feet), and 20 percent creative specialty pieces. The team has also completed interiors for custom coaches, buses, yachts, and train cars.

Customers range from homeowners seeking a single bathroom vanity or entry gate to commercial developers outfitting bank branches and law firms. The company has fabricated interiors for luxury vehicles including coaches, buses, yachts, and rail cars, and notes it is still awaiting its first airplane project.

According to founder Chuck Clowers, the business was built on solving problems, providing service, fostering creativity, and maintaining the highest standard of quality. The company highlights warranties, satisfaction guarantees, and over 38 years of experience as pillars of its approach.

about:
Geometric Innovations LLC was founded in 2009 by Jarrett Maxwell in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Initially a general home remodeling business, the company shifted its focus to woodworking, specializing in fine furniture and custom cabinetry. Maxwell, serving as artist, designer, and craftsman, operates the firm as a sole proprietorship.

The shop produces custom furniture pieces and architectural millwork for both new construction and renovation projects. Its capabilities span custom furniture design and build, cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, and built-ins, as well as a variety of millwork services. Past projects include bedroom sets, credenzas, china cabinets, tables, lighting, mirror frames, entertainment centers, hidden bookcases, and vanities. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Geometric Innovations serves private residential clients, interior designers, and architects across residential and commercial sectors. The company collaborates directly with design professionals to deliver pieces that integrate into larger architectural schemes.

Maxwell states that the company aims to blur the line between art and furniture while maintaining a firm grasp on form and function, with a stated goal of excellence in design, materials, construction, and client relationships.

name: George T. Hall Company
old_description: 90+ year manufacturer of UL-certified custom control panels
about:
George T. Hall Company (GTH) was founded in 1932 in Anaheim, California, by George Hall. Now led by Chairman Chuck Niemann and President Dina Johnson, the company has operated for over nine decades under the motto "The House That Service Built," emphasizing continuous improvement and customer partnerships.

GTH is a full-service control solutions provider that designs, programs, and manufactures UL-certified custom control panels (UL508A/UL698A) in two panel shops located in California and Nevada. As a CSIA-certified system integrator since 2017, the firm combines control panel manufacturing, field services, system integration, and product distribution under one roof, supporting the full lifecycle from design and commissioning to preventative maintenance and optimization.

The company serves public and private industrial organizations across the western United States, with documented expertise in water and wastewater, mining/minerals/metals, food and beverage, pharmaceutical and life sciences, general manufacturing, and aerospace. Its MSHA- and BROWZ-certified engineers deliver rugged controls for hazardous environments, while ISA- and FDA-aligned capabilities address regulated sectors.

GTH differentiates itself through a phased modernization approach that can reuse up to 95% of existing PLC code during SCADA migrations, reducing downtime and cost. Its ISO 9001:2015 quality system, regional knowledge, and legacy of service-driven culture underpin long-term customer relationships.

name: Gilbert Creek Woodworks
old_description: With decades of experience in the industry and proven methods, Gilbert Creek Woodworks is a premier provider of custom wood products, including kitchen cabinets, office furniture, entertainment centers, architectural millwork, and other specialty wood pieces. We make beautiful wood products that significantly enhance lives through exceptional communication, design, and manufacturing.
about:
Gilbert Creek Woodworks operates from Menomonie, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 1987 by Duane Zweber. After three decades as a production manager and head of product design for two large woodworking firms, Zweber launched his own shop to serve clients seeking custom wood products. Today the business remains a family affair, with his sons Brian and Robert contributing finishing expertise and business management respectively.

The company produces a range of custom woodwork, including kitchen cabinets, office furniture, entertainment centers, architectural millwork, and other specialty pieces. Work spans design, machining, assembly, and finishing, with Brian Zweber bringing specialized training from the National Institute of Wood Finishing. Projects are built for residential, commercial, and one-off commissions, though the facility size and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers include homeowners, businesses, and architects across the United States and internationally, as noted by the founder's experience delivering projects worldwide. The shop handles everything from single-room cabinetry to full-office fit-outs and custom entertainment centers, but no specific client names or industry certifications are published.

Zweber started the business to offer what he calls a better way of building things, emphasizing exceptional communication, design, and manufacturing. The team's philosophy centers on a collaborative process that begins with the client's vision and ends with a finished piece that enhances daily life.
